says: People argue back. Under the "not worth your money" list, viewers defend their LED masks, complain that dermatologists contradict each other, and point out the LED-mask ads sitting in the same comments. Under the skit calling "medical grade" an unregulated term, they recommend CeraVe and The Ordinary, and some defend SkinCeuticals while agreeing the label guarantees nothing. Run 1's questions ask the same thing in different words: "So LED masks and collagen tablets aren't worth it?!", "what about collagen powder?", a budget-friendly retinoid (1,116 likes) and "How much does something like this cost?"
